prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE high-fidelity visual identity comparison board for the existing web app Ear Train / Jazz Ear Lab. This is a real usable practice tool, not a landing page or a mood board. Produce a sharp large landscape image, ideally 2560x1800, with FOUR straight-on flat UI viewports in a 2x2 board: top-left desktop M2 Practice landscape; top-right MOBILE M2 Practice portrait 390x844 aspect; bottom-left desktop Insights landscape; bottom-right MOBILE Insights portrait 390x844 aspect. Desktop panels are about 2.5 times the width of the phone panels; keep generous board gutters. Each mobile UI is an actual portrait screen, not a landscape screen squeezed narrow. No device mockup hardware, no perspective, no photography, no shadows around panels. The board is for comparing one visual world across both tasks. Tiny captions OUTSIDE each viewport identify Desktop / Practice, Mobile / Practice, Desktop / Insights, Mobile / Insights. App UI is English. Use realistic legible UI typography with letter spacing zero. Small app headings, generous readable primary chord, 44px touch target intent, no overflowing text. Primary interaction content must fit every viewport; detailed Insights content may continue below fold with a visible section hint. Retain same ordered information across the four mockups and all directions. Desktop practice may use a 6-column x 2-row answer grid, phone 4-column x 3-row. Screen headers contain Jazz Ear Lab and Practice / Insights / Legacy navigation. Do not show avatars, notifications, search, streaks, MIDI/microphone controls, progress graphs, settings sidebar or unsupported functions.
Practice content EXACT: M2 Recognition; Question 4 / 20; Stop; known chord C7; Which chord degree?; Your turn; Replay with a familiar replay icon and readable label. Twelve unselected canonical degree options in exact row-major order: 1, b9, 9, b3, 3, 11, #11, 5, b13, 13, b7, maj7. Keep all twelve distinct and equal, none selected and no answer disclosed. No Reveal before an incorrect answer, no Next before resolution. A secondary collapsed Session settings disclosure is permitted. DO NOT make a piano keyboard, musical staff, notation chart, fake waveform or sound visualizer. This task is degree recognition against the known chord, not chord identification.
Insights content is coherent ILLUSTRATIVE data, not real user history. Visibly label Example data discreetly on Insights. Heading Insights. Compact comparison scope: M2 Recognition; Context on; Previously seen; 18-24 Oct 2026; All matching sessions. Scope details can be a disclosure, not many chips. Native-looking selectors: Root: All; Quality: 7. Main evidence: First-answer accuracy 70%, 28 / 40 assessed, 2 unassessed. Supporting evidence: Replay-assisted 8 / 40; Correct-response median 2.4 s, n=24 valid. Clear next section Patterns worth attention: 7 / b7 at 60%, 12 / 20, replay-assisted 5 / 20; adjacent readable Customize focus command. Secondary comparison 7 / 3 at 80%, 16 / 20, replay-assisted 3 / 20. If bars are used lengths represent 60% and 80%, with direct numeric labels and sample sizes. Caption near pattern: Descriptive pattern, not a confirmed weakness. Then compact collapsed Detailed breakdown and Sessions. Evidence order stays scope -> performance -> patterns -> practice action -> detailed records. Phone may omit the second pattern from first viewport, never shrink all text to fit. No curves, invented trend, mastery score, health score, AI recommendation or green/red success confetti. Do not bury critical denominators.
Visual world for this board: ENSEMBLE SCORE. A contemporary ensemble part translated into a precise digital daily practice instrument, not a sheet-music facsimile, not a marketing page, not an ordinary blue SaaS dashboard. Cool luminous white #FAFCFF, deep charcoal-navy #171D2C TEXT ONLY, confident saturated cobalt #234AC7 structural brackets, very small sharp citrus #E2F26A location cues. Strong music-publishing grotesk akin Franklin Gothic / IBM Plex Sans, with an excellent readable large C7 and tabular count numerals. No serif, no cream paper, no calligraphy, no textures. Short cobalt solid rehearsal-like number blocks for section/location, not numbered extra steps or an invented musical symbol. The top navigation is compact and angular; whitespace is measured by aligned horizontal baselines. M2 chord C7 dominates the center-left open field, a wide unframed answer grid below it like two measured musical rows, every degree readable. Replay is secondary, ink outline plus replay icon. Radius no more than 3px. Stop is quiet, not the dominant color. NO actual musical staves, notation, fake waveforms, extra colored-keyboard or colored answer hints. Insights translates to a confident score-like hierarchy: 70% and correct/assessed anchor one strong line, replay and time are subordinate, then labeled horizontal bars and adjacent Customize focus. A tiny citrus rehearsal mark at the CURRENT task is the signature. Mobile preserves chord, task and four-column answer order with generous target spacing. No sidebar, no floating cards, no gradients. Emphasize the label First-answer accuracy near 70%. Use ONLY the supplied cautious pattern caption, verbatim; never invent particular degree confusions, musical explanations, causal diagnoses or performance claims.
